name: Treant Muisek
summary: In Feralas, Witch Doctor Uzer'i turns your search to the wandering treants. After the faerie dragons, he sends you to find three forest walkers.

sections.title: Slow Protectors
sections.body: The night elves have made treants their allies against the Horde. Uzer'i says they move slowly, yet none can deny their strength as protectors. He means to put that strength to work for the Horde.

sections.title: Three Forest Walkers
sections.body: Uzer'i asks you to find and kill three wandering forest walkers. When each treant falls, use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture it.

sections.title: Uzer'i's Verdict
sections.body: When you return, Witch Doctor Uzer'i thanks you. He says the collection of muisek is nearly complete.

faq.q: Who sends adventurers after the treants?
faq.answer: Witch Doctor Uzer'i sends you after the treants, following the faerie dragons.

faq.q: Why does Witch Doctor Uzer'i want treant muisek?
faq.answer: The night elves have made treants their allies against the Horde. Uzer'i wants their protective power put to work for the Horde.

faq.q: What creatures must be found for Treant Muisek?
faq.answer: You need to find three wandering forest walkers roaming the forest.
When a wandering forest walker falls, use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture it.

faq.q: Where does Treant Muisek fit among Uzer'i's requests?
aliases: what comes after faerie dragon muisek
faq.answer: Treant Muisek follows Faerie Dragon Muisek. Mountain Giant Muisek comes next.
